SELECT T1.DocumentID,
	CASE WHEN T1.ClassName = 'BDO.Person' THEN P.PersonLastName + ', ' + P.PersonFirstName
		ELSE IP.LastName + ', ' + IP.FirstName END AS Name
FROM View_CMS_Tree_Joined AS T1 WITH (NOEXPAND)
INNER JOIN View_CMS_Tree_Joined AS T2 WITH (NOEXPAND)ON T1.NodeParentID = T2.NodeID
LEFT JOIN BDO_Person AS P ON P.PersonID = T1.DocumentForeignKeyValue  AND T1.ClassName = 'BDO.Person'
LEFT  JOIN BDO_InternalPerson AS IP ON IP.InternalPersonID = T1.DocumentForeignKeyValue AND T1.ClassName = 'BDO.InternalPerson'

  AND T2.ClassName IN ('BDO.SectionPeoplePage', 'BDO.InternalPeopleFolder')
